title: English Practice Exercises
content:
Overview

English: These exercises cover all major components of English—grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, and speaking—to improve overall fluency.
Hindi: Ye abhyas English ke sabhi mool tatvon—vyakaran, shabdawali, pathan, lekhan, aur bolne—par aadharit hain, taaki aapki bhasha ki pakad majboot ho.

Example: Practice filling in blanks, identifying tenses, creating sentences, or matching idioms.
Hindi: Jaise khali sthal bharna, kaal pehchanna, vaakya banana, ya muhavare jodna.

title: Grammar Exercises
content:
Focus Areas

English: Strengthen your grammar skills with tense, preposition, modal, and voice exercises.
Hindi: Kaal, sambandh suchak shabd, modals, aur kriya roop (voice) ke abhyas se vyaakaran majboot banaiye.

  • Fill in the blanks: using correct tenses.
  • Choose the correct preposition.
  • Transform active to passive voice.
  • Use correct modal verbs (can, may, should).
Example: She ______ (go) to school every day. → She goes to school every day.
Hindi: Wah roz school ______ (jaana) hai → Wah roz school jaati hai.

title: Vocabulary Exercises
content:
Focus Areas

English: Build word power with synonym, antonym, and word meaning quizzes.
Hindi: Parayavachi (synonym), vilom (antonym), aur shabdarth (word meaning) ke quiz se apna shabd gyaan badhaiye.

  • Match words with meanings.
  • Find synonyms and antonyms.
  • Choose correct word usage in a sentence.
Example: Choose the synonym of ‘happy’. (a) sad (b) glad (c) angry → glad.
Hindi: ‘Happy’ ka paryayavachi chunein: (a) sad (b) glad (c) angry → glad.

title: Reading Comprehension
content:
Focus Areas

English: Improve understanding through short paragraphs and question-based exercises.
Hindi: Chhoti pathan kahaniyon aur prashnottar ke madhyam se samajhne ki kshamata badhaiye.

  • Read a passage and answer questions.
  • Identify the main idea and supporting details.
  • Guess word meanings from context.
Example: Passage: ‘The sun rises in the east.’ Question: Where does the sun rise? → In the east.
Hindi: Prashn: Surya kahan se ugta hai? → Purva disha se.

title: Writing Practice
content:
Focus Areas

English: Strengthen writing by completing sentence starters, essays, and emails.
Hindi: Apni lekhan kaushal badhaiye vaakya poora karne, nibandh aur email likhne ke madhyam se.

  • Complete the sentence logically.
  • Write a short paragraph on a topic.
  • Correct grammatical errors in sentences.
Example: Start with: ‘If I were a bird, ...’ → If I were a bird, I would fly everywhere.
Hindi: ‘Agar main pakshi hota, ...’ → Toh main har jagah udta.

title: Speaking Exercises
content:
Focus Areas

English: Build fluency and pronunciation through dialogues and role-plays.
Hindi: Sanvaad aur abhinay ke madhyam se apni pravahmay bolne ki kshamata aur ucharan sudhariye.

  • Practice introducing yourself.
  • Talk about daily routine and hobbies.
  • Use idioms naturally in speech.
Example: A: How are you?
B: I’m on cloud nine! (very happy)
Hindi: A: Aap kaise hain?
B: Main bahut khush hoon!

title: Listening Exercises
content:
Focus Areas

English: Improve listening through stories, podcasts, and dictations.
Hindi: Kahani, podcast, aur dictation ke dwara apne sunne ke kaushal par kaam kijiye.

  • Listen to short audios and write answers.
  • Fill in missing words from audio clips.
  • Repeat and shadow sentences for pronunciation.
Example: Audio: ‘The boy is reading.’ → Write what you hear.
Hindi: Audio sunkar likhiye: ‘The boy is reading.’ → ‘Ladka padh raha hai.’

title: Mixed Practice Tests
content:
Combine All Skills

English: Integrated exercises test grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, and usage together.
Hindi: Milijuli prashnavali se aapka vyakaran, shabdawali, samajh, aur prayog sabhi ka parikshan hota hai.

  • Multiple-choice grammar questions.
  • Reading passage with fill-in-the-blanks.
  • Choose idioms, phrasal verbs, or correct tense forms.
Example: She ______ her homework before dinner. (a) finish (b) finishes (c) finished → finished.
Hindi: Usne khane se pehle apna kaam ______. (a) kiya (b) karti (c) karna → kiya.

title: Self-Improvement Tips
content:
Tips

  • Practice English 20 minutes daily.
  • Watch English movies with subtitles.
  • Read aloud to improve pronunciation.
  • Keep a vocabulary journal.
  • Review your mistakes and correct them.
Example: Create a daily goal like learning 5 new words.
Hindi: Har din 5 naye shabd seekhne ka lakshya rakhiye.
